notes.tech: Thread proposed 3 (2026-10-10): StormRepel DWR; FreeShade UPF; FreeDry; WeatherEdge; ThermaFill; AirSpace; Rainfoil; Windfoil — owned marks (Eddie Bauer registered names over unnamed supplier fabrics) plus licensed Polygiene, TENCEL and bluesign; share of range 24% (65/267 styles name a mark in PDP features or materials; StormRepel 45, Free. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.
notes.craft: Thread proposed 2 (2026-10-10): Eddie Bauer gives a dated and placed origin (Seattle, 1920) and a documented first: the patented down jacket. It names no factory, maker or mill on any of 267 men's PDPs, and only 15 PDPs say anything about origin, all of them just 'Imported'. That is heritage without verifiable making. It sits between 1 and 2; 2 is proposed because the history can be checked. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.

craft_evidence.owned: no (no factory, mill or workshop named anywhere on eddiebauer.com; Our Story page gives history only)
craft_evidence.mills: none on the 267 PDPs read (bluesign-approved fabric is a certification, not a mill)
craft_evidence.madein: 6% (15/267 PDPs say Imported; none names a country)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed: Bauer's Sports Shop opened 1920, Seattle; first patented down jacket in America; outfitted first American Everest ascent (Our Story page)
craft_evidence.process: no; Legend Wash is called an exclusive process but is not described; nothing else on how garments are made
craft_evidence.reasoning: Eddie Bauer gives a dated and placed origin (Seattle, 1920) and a documented first: the patented down jacket. It names no factory, maker or mill on any of 267 men's PDPs, and only 15 PDPs say anything about origin, all of them just 'Imported'. That is heritage without verifiable making. It sits between 1 and 2; 2 is proposed because the history can be checked.

ownership.owner: Authentic Brands Group (owns the Eddie Bauer IP); US e-commerce and wholesale operated by licensee Outdoor 5, LLC since 2 Feb 2026; the former North American store operator Eddie Bauer LLC (store licence held by Catalyst Brands) filed Chapter 11 on 9 Feb 2026
